title: General
description: The URLs this instance is reached at, its license, who can see the machine list, and who can see resource activity.

url.label: Application URL
url.description: The URL users access Attraccess at (used for redirects, links, and API callbacks).

errors.invalid: Enter a full URL, including http:// or https://.

publicInternetUrl.label: Public Internet URL
publicInternetUrl.description: Optional URL used for external callbacks (e.g. SumUp).

errors.invalid: Enter a full URL, including http:// or https://.

licenseKey.label: License Key
licenseKey.description: Paste a new license key to update. Leave empty to keep the current one. If a valid new key changes which plugins may load (for example WAGO), the server restarts automatically.

listVisibility.label: Who can see the machine list
listVisibility.description: Controls who sees which machines exist. People managing resources always see all machines. A machine that is hidden from someone answers as not found.
listVisibility.permitted-only: Only people introduced to a machine
listVisibility.permittedOnlyHint: People see only machines they are introduced to (directly or through a group), introduce or maintain, or currently use. Nobody else learns that the other machines exist. This keeps the equipment list of your space from anyone who creates an account.
listVisibility.authenticatedHint: Every signed-in account with Read Resources sees all machines. With open self-registration, anyone can create an account and read your equipment list.
listVisibility.loadFailed: The machine list setting could not be loaded.

activityVisibility.label: Who can see resource activity
activityVisibility.description: Controls who sees which resources are in use and by whom. People always see their own sessions.
activityVisibility.introduced: Only people introduced to the resource
activityVisibility.introducedHint: Only people introduced to a resource (directly or through a group), its introducers and maintainers, and users with Update Resources or Manage Resource Access see its activity. On resources that allow or require supervised use, everyone else sees only Available or In Use, without a name.
activityVisibility.loadFailed: The resource activity setting could not be loaded.
